summary.text: Mark Duncan, listed by Ballotpedia as P. Mark Duncan, is a Republican state representative from New Mexico House District 2 who took office on January 1, 2023, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: In the 2025-2026 session, Duncan serves on the Appropriations and Finance Committee, the Commerce & Economic Development Committee, the Rules and Order of Business Committee and the Taxation & Revenue Committee.
